title: Hard to write text after image
content:
I find it hard to write text after I inserted an image. Especially between two images.
I end up writing nonsense text first as a placeholder and inserting the images around that. Then I edit the placeholder text.
The old forum had a html view where you could easily place the blinking cursor after the image closing tag.

For example it is hard to put text under the first image:

 

The cursor can only be set to the image caption below the first image:

So then I need to delete the second image first to get in between.

I also don’t see the option to set image size anymore. Is it always full size?

scraped_replies.html:
Yes, I have noticed this - it is, indeed, a pain.

 

I also don’t see the option to set image size anymore

Already noted:

Thank you for sharing your experience with adding multiple images, ​@unsigned_char_array, and ​@Andrew Neil for adding your input. 

It is indeed not ideal, however, I believe it is current platform functionality. We are sharing this as well with our platform provider to see if we can improve this. 

Kind Regards, 
Zita
